```yaml
name: Devin on Label

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  devin-session:
    if: github.event.label.name == 'devin'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Read issue data
        id: issue
        run: |
          echo "TITLE=$(jq -r '.issue.title' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "URL=$(jq -r '.issue.html_url' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "BODY=$(jq -r '.issue.body' $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Create Devin session
        id: devin
        env:
          DEVIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          PROMPT="Issue: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.TITLE }}\nURL: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.URL }}\nBody: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.BODY }}"
          PROMPT_JSON=$(printf '%s\n' "$PROMPT" | jq -R .)
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.devin.ai/v1/sessions \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEVIN_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"prompt_text\": $PROMPT_JSON}")
          SESSION_URL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.session_url')
          echo "SESSION_URL=$SESSION_URL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Comment on issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          SESSION_URL: ${{ steps.devin.outputs.SESSION_URL }}
        with:
          script: |
            const issueNumber = context.issue.number;
            const sessionUrl = process.env.SESSION_URL;
            if (!sessionUrl) {
              core.setFailed('No session URL returned from Devin API');
              return;
            }
            const commentBody = `✅ Devin session created: ${sessionUrl}`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber,
              body: commentBody
            });
```
